description: The plain optional contains a one-item route and a flat-brace route. A capture in that optional changes no query answer. The present route reads the D tokens and then the written T, so .begins(r) is false (engine §4). Only the equivalent one-item route binds c, since captures inside braces are forbidden (engine §9.3).
grammar:
%rule text $r:input
%conditions $r.begins(r)
%rule input B {D} T
%rule r :: Queried | B [($c:c | {c})] [+T] D T
%rule c D
